name: Ikutsuki Shuuji
source:
The chairman of the board for Gekkoukan High School and adviser to the Specialized Extracurricular Execution Squad. 

He's polite, sophisticated, and friendly. Always accompanied with a gentle smile and a set of bad puns. 

[Based on the [url=https://megamitensei.fandom.com/wiki/Shuji_Ikutsuki]Wiki[/url]]
